dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.intro: Where you are on the road to your keys, and the numbers behind it.
dashboard.xpNote: XP, 25 for each step you complete.
dashboard.synced: Your progress is saved to your account.
dashboard.allDone: Every step is done. Put the kettle on.
dashboard.numbersSaved: Maximum property price, based on the figures in your calculator.
dashboard.numbersHint: Fill in the calculator and choose Save to my journey to see your numbers here. They stay in this browser.

profile.title: My profile
profile.intro: Your details and how your account works.

password.title: Password
password.text: Use at least 8 characters, with a capital letter and a special character.

data.title: Your data
data.text: Your account stores your name, your email and the steps you have completed, on servers in Ireland. With Google, it also keeps the profile picture link Google sends, which we do not use. The figures you type into the calculator stay in your browser. Read our Privacy Policy.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.text: Your progress stays saved in your account for next time.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.text: This deletes your account and the progress saved in it, straight away. It cannot be undone. The calculator figures in this browser are not part of your account and stay here.
delete.question: Delete the account for and all its saved progress? You can create a new account later, but this one cannot be brought back.
delete.done: Your account and its saved progress have been deleted.
delete.failed: Your account could not be deleted. Please try again.
delete.signInAgain: Sign in again to delete your account.
delete.notEnabled: Deleting accounts from the site is not switched on yet. Email eirehomeflow@gmail.com and we will delete it for you.
delete.note: Cannot sign in any more? Email eirehomeflow@gmail.com from the address on the account and we will delete it for you.
